name: data_deannotation
author: Youssef Megahed
description: Removes annotations (OCR-detected text, colored marks and small grayscale marks) from images by inpainting. The input folder is processed recursively and all results are saved as .tif.

inputs.name: Input images folder
inputs.description: A folder (FileCollection) containing images (.png, .jpg, .jpeg, .bmp, .tif, .tiff), possibly in sub-folders

inputs.name: Output folder name
inputs.description: Name of the folder that will contain the inpainted images

output-files.name: Inpainted images
output-files.description: Folder of de-annotated .tif images, same structure as the input
